hallucinations.claim: "the most powerful GPU right now is the NVIDIA H200"
hallucinations.why: Trap: H200 is a 2023/2024 Hopper part two generations back; Blackwell Ultra (B300/GB300) ships in volume and Vera Rubin is in first shipments as of Oct 2026. Wrong central verdict.

hallucinations.claim: "NVIDIA H200 (Blackwell architecture)"
hallucinations.why: The H200 is Hopper, not Blackwell.

hallucinations.claim: "up to 1,500 TFLOPS of FP8 throughput when fully configured as a 16-chip unit"
hallucinations.why: Invented figure and configuration; there is no 16-chip H200 unit, and a single H200 is ~1,979 dense FP8 TFLOPS (3,958 sparse), so 1,500 for 16 chips is nonsense.

hallucinations.claim: "Google's TPU v5p holds the lead" / "Gemini uses TPU v5p pods exclusively"
hallucinations.why: Trap: TPU v5p is a 2023 part; Ironwood (TPU v7) has been GA since April 2026 and TPU 8t/8i were announced in April 2026.

hallucinations.claim: "Google's proprietary NOC interconnect"
hallucinations.why: TPU pods use ICI (inter-chip interconnect) plus optical circuit switches; 'NOC interconnect' is invented terminology.

hallucinations.claim: "pod-level performance in the petascale range (4K+ chips)"
hallucinations.why: Understates by orders of magnitude: a v5p pod is ~4 exaflops (bf16) and an Ironwood pod ~42.5 FP8 exaflops.

hallucinations.claim: "Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Anthropic's latest)"
hallucinations.why: Claude 3.5 Sonnet is a 2024 model; the current lineup is Fable 5.1 / Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 / Haiku 5.5.

hallucinations.claim: "runs on a hybrid stack of H100s, H200s, and Anthropic's own ASICs—the Anthropic Infernet, a TPU-like chip optimized for sparse attention"
hallucinations.why: Invented chip. Anthropic's stated platforms are AWS Trainium (over 1M Trainium2), Google TPUs (up to 1M TPU deal) and Nvidia GPUs; it only announced an in-house chip-design team in Aug 2026, with no shipped ASIC. Omits Trainium and TPUs entirely.

hallucinations.why: Stale: OpenAI runs GB200/GB300 via Microsoft, Oracle and CoreWeave, is adding AMD MI450 from H2 2026 and has Broadcom custom silicon in progress.

hallucinations.claim: "Meta and DeepMind mix AMD MI300X ... and NVIDIA GPUs"
hallucinations.why: DeepMind is Google and trains on TPUs, not MI300X; Meta uses Nvidia plus AMD (MI450 6 GW deal) and its own MTIA; MI300X is a two-generation-old trap part.

hallucinations.claim: "Neither is widely available outside of hyperscalers—NVIDIA's H200 is the open-market king"
hallucinations.why: Self-contradictory and stale; H200 is sold widely through neoclouds and is no longer the top part.

hallucinations.claim: "Anthropic hasn't released details—expect sparse attention optimization and high-bandwidth memory as the differentiators"
